business_problem: Qatar Charity, a renowned non-profit organization dedicated to humanitarian efforts worldwide, faced significant challenges with inefficient call center operations and fragmented data management systems.
solution_summary: Qatar Charity used Microsoft Copilot Studio, Dynamics 365 Customer Service, Azure Communication Services to replace disconnected manual workflows with a more consistent digital operating model. Customer and service data that had been scattered across CRM, service, and support tools were consolidated into Dynamics 365 so sales, case handling, dispatch, and reporting could run on a single omnichannel platform. Low-code automation and copilot capabilities orchestrate tasks, route work, and surface context to agents or business users without requiring separate point solutions. It also connects with surrounding systems such as WhatsApp, Call-center telephony, which lets the new Azure-based workflow fit into existing operations rather than standing apart from them.
